results.title: Andrew Schulz: LIFE
results.overview: In this razor-sharp yet heartfelt special, Andrew Schulz unpacks the wildest moment of his life — becoming a father.

results.title: Putin's Spies
results.overview: Never before in Russian history has the Russian domestic intelligence services been more powerful than today. The FSB is a murky organisation that can ruin people’s lives who are deemed enemies of the Russian state and even commit murder on behalf of the Kremlin. Four people in exile open up about their experiences with the FSB.

results.title: Maijharo
results.overview: A man’s desperate fight to save his father’s graveyard from a powerful businessman is complicated by the return of his former lover.

results.title: History of Darkness
results.overview: A History of Darkness summons the figures of Nero, Dante, the Marquis de Sade and Ludwig II in the intoxication of their obsessions, between ecstasy and damnation, fascination and repulsion. A family portrait teetering on the edge of the abyss.

results.title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2025
results.overview: The 2025 Worlds Collide was a professional wrestling event and supercard co-produced by the American promotion WWE and its Mexican subsidiary Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA). It took place Saturday, June 7, 2025, at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California.

results.title: Snap
results.overview: A lone photographer at a mountain cabin grows suspicious that she might be someone else's subject.

results.title: ACA 190: Gasanov vs. Aryshev
results.overview: ACA 190: Gasanov vs. Aryshev was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Friday, August 15, 2025 at the Irina Viner Usmanova Gymnastics Palace in Moscow, Russia.

results.title: Parasite 3
results.overview: Tassa, Toostie, and Karma are all victims of a parasitic entity that acts as an unseen force infiltrating their lives and feeding off of them.

results.title: Ceasefire
results.overview: Hazira survived Srebrenica. She saw the war, it corroded her life. She has been stuck in a refugee camp in her own country for 29 years, working hard and unceasingly to make ends meet and keep the trauma at bay.

results.title: It Will Always End in the End
results.overview: Gabriel Drolet-Maguire, a designer living in Montreal, takes us into their artistic world to discuss their HIV diagnosis. This is a timely and hopeful look at past and present day HIV/AIDS activism in Quebec.

results.title: The Kirlian Frequency
results.overview: A late-night radio station, a cadaverous host, and five guests with five unusual stories of horror and science fiction are the focus of the film adaptation of the cult animated series The Kirlian Frequency.  What really happened that night to the radio station, the city, and its inhabitants? And most importantly... Why?

results.title: Being Dead Should Be Easy
results.overview: A Jewish Millennial woman has a breakdown at her great-aunt’s shiva when she learns that there’s no room left for her in the family mausoleum.

An explosion in the subway takes Rasul's life, leaving his family grieving for his son for 15 long years. However, on Memorial Day, Rasul returns home. The family is shocked - the joy of reunion is mixed with the bitterness of the question “Where have you been all this time?”.  Rasul is evading the question, and each member of his family has their own assumptions about this.

results.title: Thanks for Nothing
results.overview: Katharina, Ricky, Victoria and Malou live in an assisted living group. There they have built up an anarchic utopia as an alternative to everything they reject: Parents, school, rules. With social worker Ballack as a half-hearted guardian, things go well until their “live and let live” agreement starts to falter.

results.title: Astronaut
results.overview: Nicolás is a well-known TV presenter and a frustrated writer who appears to lead a successful life, both professionally and romantically. However, just as he’s about to move into the wonderful new house he’s bought with his wife, he encounters an old soul who prompts him to question his monotonous life by recounting fantastic stories. Thanks to this strange new presence in his life and the rekindling of his old love for writing, Nicolás will search for true happiness.

results.title: Disney Jr. Cinema Club 2025
results.overview: Audiences are invited to bring their little ones to enjoy the magic of Disney on the big screen, with a new fun-filled cinema experience featuring Mickey Mouse, Spidey and His Amazing Friends, Ariel, Bluey and more.  Whether it’s their first time in the cinema, or they regularly enjoy the movies, it’s one not to miss! DISNEY JUNIOR CINEMA CLUB 2025 brings together songs, interactive games, and episodes for pre-schoolers

results.title: Strand: The Cold Open
results.overview: A troubled woman with nowhere else to go visits a man burdened by a strange curse.

results.title: Lev Berger
results.overview: When the sound recordist realises that their TV report involving the country’s most popular politician has been faked, he sets out to find the truth.

results.title: Kids Fight
results.overview: Childhood poverty in Pakistan can be nearly impossible to escape...but some local gyms are giving the street kids of Pakistan a potential chance to climb their way out into a better life in the world of MMA.
